description: Maintainer decision (adversary pass 6, F14/F19): "Newlines have zero meaning here." F14: a `</parameter>` mid-line in a newline-framed value, then prose, then the closer that ends the value. The closer is unpaired and text follows it, so the reading holding the text (`tool_call.value.text-after-closer`) and the reading ending the value at that closer and dropping the text (`tool_call.markup.text-between-parameters`) tie: the mutating `set` call is Ambiguous between `rm -rf build</parameter> Then I set b.` and `rm -rf build`, never usable (issue #3: "Never accept trailing free text as an argument"). Same outcome class as the closer on a line of its own (qwen_value_holds_text_between_closers).
input:
<tool_call>
<function=set>
<parameter=a>
rm -rf build</parameter> Then I set b.
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
